synthesis.appearance_hypotheses: Repeated model-generated captions included a black background with a green circle (2 frames); a colorful orb with a black background (2 frames); a black and white cat (2 frames). Frequent prompt-relative hypotheses: light: neon lighting (22/32 frames); material: smooth digital surfaces (32/32 frames); medium: a 3D render (31/32 frames); setting: an abstract composition (21/32 frames); tone: a tense ominous image (24/32 frames).
synthesis.audio_control: 16 matched programme-versus-silence comparisons had median hue divergence 0.024 bits. Differences may also reflect unseeded projectM rendering or feedback evolution, not just musical response.

Still frames cannot establish flash safety or perceived motion quality. Only an authenticated artist-provided suite can establish behaviour on actual album audio.

synthesis.scope: Observed 32 paired source/output measurements across 8 declared conditions, including 2 cover/lyric conditions and output times 0, 0.5, 1.5, 3 seconds.
synthesis.temporal_behaviour: For successive captures of the same input condition, median measured texture divergence was 0.014 bits across 24 transitions.
